map.按水体散热与覆盖保温情况，计算维持越冬水温所需加热功率: Compute the heating power needed to keep a pond or tank above a target temperature in winter.
map.📖 查看「越冬保温加热功率计算使用指南」: 📖 View the "Overwinter Insulation Heating Power Guide"
map.热损失 Q=U×A×ΔT×风速系数；U 为传热系数(W/m²·℃)：敞开水面约: Heat loss Q = U × A × ΔT × wind factor; U is the heat-transfer coefficient (W/m²·℃): about 10 for an open water surface, 6 for single-layer film, 3 for double-layer film and 1.5 for insulated panels. Required power = Q × (1 + margin%) ÷ 1000 (kW). An open surface loses far more heat through evaporation, so covering the pond is recommended.

map.双层薄膜 U=3、室内外温差 18.0℃：热损失约 12960 W；含 30%: Double-layer film with U = 3 and an indoor-outdoor temperature difference of 18.0 ℃: heat loss is about 12960 W; with a 30% margin the required heating power is about 16.85 kW and daily consumption about 404.4 kWh, a moderate energy use, so strengthen insulation to cut heat loss.
map.传热系数 U 表示围护结构单位面积、单位温差的传热速率(W/m²·℃)；U 越小: The heat-transfer coefficient U is the rate of heat transfer per unit area and unit temperature difference of the enclosure (W/m²·℃); the smaller U is, the better the insulation, and double layers or added insulation cut heat loss markedly.
map.怎么降低加热能耗？: How can heating energy use be reduced?
map.提高保温（双层膜+内保温被）、减小温差、用热泵替代直电热、夜间加盖，可大幅削减日: Better insulation (double-layer film plus an inner thermal blanket), a smaller temperature difference, heat pumps instead of direct electric heating and extra night covers can greatly cut daily consumption.
